text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When you identify bugs in your code, the first step is to understand what the program is actually doing. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to watch how the code runs. A systematic approach is also important: reproduce the problem, isolate the cause, and test one change at a time. Good logging helps a lot, because log messages show what happened before an error appeared. Instead of guessing, read the logs carefully and check your assumptions. With patience and the right tools, most bugs can be found and fixed quickly.
